# Pinned environment of the archived training / instrumentation / analysis
# artifact (the versions the paper's runs and figures were produced with).
# Python 3.14; the CUDA build used for training was torch 2.12.1+cu132,
# resolved from the PyTorch wheel index:
#   pip install torch==2.12.1 --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu132
# (CPU audits used the +cu130 wheel; both import surfaces match).
# See requirements.lock for the complete transitive freeze; the direct
# pins here and the freeze are generated from the same environment and
# must not disagree.
torch==2.12.1
numpy==2.4.4
sentencepiece==0.2.1
datasets==5.0.0
torchtune==0.6.1
# torchao is REQUIRED by torchtune 0.6.1 at import time and must be
# pinned: 0.17.0 is the audited environment's version and its import
# surface is verified compatible (torchtune imports and the
# pretokenization path runs); 0.18.0 lacks the import surface
# torchtune 0.6.1 expects and does NOT work.
torchao==0.17.0
matplotlib==3.11.1

# development / test
pytest==9.1.1
